title: Article: How Mantra Jaap Reduces Planetary Effects | The Hidden Science Explained

segments.text: What if the planets influence your life in ways that cannot be seen with ordinary eyes?
Have you ever wondered why, despite putting in the same effort, one person’s life moves forward with ease while another constantly faces obstacles?
Many people believe the answer lies in the Nine Planets (Navagraha) . But an even bigger question is:
How can planets that are millions of kilometers away influence our thoughts, emotions, decisions, and even the events of our lives?

Guru Tattva offers a fascinating perspective on this mystery. Before understanding how mantra chanting can reduce planetary influence, we first need to understand how these planets are connected to us in the first place.
Let’s explore this step by step.
The Invisible Connection Between Humans and the Planets
What if every person carries the imprint of the Nine Planets?
Every person born in a human body remains connected to the Nine Planets throughout life.
This connection is not through the physical planets we see in the sky. Instead, it exists through nine subtle planetary waves .
These waves are invisible to ordinary eyes but can be perceived through the Third Eye (Drishti).
Think of it like your mobile phone.

You cannot see the network signals around you, yet your phone remains connected to them all the time. In the same way, these subtle planetary waves continuously remain connected to every human being, silently influencing different aspects of life.
Reading the Planetary Waves
What if your horoscope could be seen instead of calculated?
When someone visits Ashaeiynn , there is no need to begin with astrological calculations.
Through the Third Eye , Bhaiya observes these subtle planetary waves directly.
By reading them, he can understand:
Which planets are naturally strong.
Which planets are weak.
The current condition of the planetary influences at that very moment.
Rather than depending solely on a horoscope, the waves themselves reveal the person’s present planetary state.
Why the Third Eye Is Different
The only instrument that can observe without being influenced.
A natural question arises.
If every human being is influenced by the planets, then how can anyone observe these planetary waves accurately?
Imagine trying to measure boiling water with a thermometer that melts in the heat.
It would never give the correct reading.
The same principle applies here.
If the Third Eye were also influenced by the planets, it would never be able to perceive their true condition.
This is why Drishti is regarded as an instrument that remains beyond planetary influence, allowing these subtle waves to be observed exactly as they are.
The Next Mystery
Can this invisible connection with the planets be changed?
If planetary waves remain connected to every human being, does that mean their influence is permanent?
Or is there a way to gradually reduce their hold?
This is where the deeper science of mantra chanting begins.

As we move forward, we’ll explore how ancient saints discovered a path that gradually transforms a person’s relationship with the planets—not by changing the planets themselves, but by changing the practitioner’s own spiritual state.
The Mystery of the Space Element
What if the most powerful part of your existence is the one you cannot see?
We often hear that the human body is made of five elements —Earth, Water, Fire, Air, and Space (Akash Tattva).
The first four are easy to understand because they are connected to the physical body. But the Space Element is very different.
Here, “space” does not mean the outer universe filled with stars and planets.
Instead, it refers to a subtle element that exists within every human being.
This element is considered the foundation of the Astral Body , the subtler aspect of our existence.
Why Is the Space Element So Powerful?
The one element that planets cannot control.
As we discussed earlier, planetary influences affect human life through subtle planetary waves.
But there is one element within us that remains beyond their control—the Space Element .
When the saints discovered this, they realized something extraordinary:
If the planets cannot influence the Space Element, then it can become a doorway to a level of existence beyond planetary limitations.
This is why so many ancient spiritual practices focused on developing and strengthening this element.
The Birth of the Astral Body
How did saints create a body beyond the physical body?
The saints began working with the Space Element and gradually created an exact subtle duplicate of the physical body within it.
This subtle duplicate came to be known as the Astral Body (Sukshma Sharir).
Imagine looking into a mirror.
The reflection looks exactly like you, but it is not your physical body.
In a similar way, the Astral Body is described as a subtle counterpart of the physical body.
But the saints did not stop there.
Through spiritual practices, they continuously directed physical energy into the Space Element, strengthening and expanding this subtle body.
As this process continued, multiple astral forms could be developed and used for spiritual work.
From the Physical World to the Astral World
Where does the energy go?
To understand this, imagine pouring water from one container into another.
The water remains the same, but it now exists in a different container.
In the same way, the saints learned how to take energy from the physical world and direct it into the Space Element.
Over time, this subtle field became what is known as the Astral Realm or Spiritual Realm .
According to this understanding, the Astral World is vast beyond imagination.
It is not limited by the physical boundaries that we experience on Earth.
Why Is the Astral World So Powerful?
Because generations of saints have worked within it.
The Astral World did not become powerful overnight.
For countless years, saints directed their spiritual efforts into this realm.
Each practice, each realization, and each spiritual accomplishment contributed to its growth.
You can think of it like a library.
A single book contains knowledge, but after thousands of scholars contribute to it over generations, it becomes a vast storehouse of wisdom.
In the same way, generations of saints continuously worked within the Astral World, causing it to expand and become a tremendous source of spiritual power.
And this raises an even bigger question:
If the Astral World exists beyond planetary influence, can it help a person reduce the effects of the planets on their life?
That is where the journey becomes even more fascinating.
The Secret to Reducing Planetary Influence
What if the solution isn’t changing the planets—but changing where your energy works?
If the planets influence our physical life, then a natural question arises:
Can their influence ever be reduced?
According to this understanding, the answer is yes .
The key is not found in the physical body, but in the Astral World , which is connected to the Space Element (Akash Tattva) .
When a person’s spiritual energy gradually begins working through the Space Element instead of only the physical body, the influence of the planets starts becoming weaker.
But how does this connection begin?
The Bridge Between Two Worlds
How did the saints learn to send energy beyond the physical world?
Throughout history, different spiritual traditions have discovered their own methods of working with the Space Element.
In India, this path has mainly developed through Bhakti, mantra chanting, and other spiritual practices.
The saints discovered that it is possible to transfer spiritual energy from the physical world into the Astral World .
This extraordinary process is known as Jagrikaran .
In simple words, Jagrikaran means awakening a spiritual connection between the physical and the Astral World.
What Does Jagrikaran Really Mean?
The moment spiritual energy begins its journey.
Imagine writing a message on your phone.
Until you press “Send,” the message remains only with you.
The moment you send it, it reaches another person through a completely different network.
Jagrikaran works in a similar way.
The saints discovered how to send spiritual energy from the physical world into the Astral World through the Space Element .
Once that connection is established, energy can also travel back from the Astral World into the physical world.
This is why the process is known as awakening .
The Real Meaning of Pran Pratishtha
Why is an energized idol considered alive?
Most people know Pran Pratishtha as the ritual performed before installing a deity in a temple.
But its meaning is much deeper.
When an idol becomes Pran Pratishthit , the saints establish a living connection between the physical world and the Astral World through the Space Element .
Because of this connection, the idol is no longer regarded as an ordinary piece of stone.
It becomes spiritually active.
This is why many people feel peace, devotion, or powerful spiritual vibrations while standing before an energized deity, even though nothing unusual is visible to the eyes.
Why Is Human Birth So Precious?
The ability that even divine beings seek.
According to this understanding, the human body is unique because it possesses the Space Element in a way that allows energy to move between the physical and the Astral Worlds.
This ability makes human birth extremely valuable.
It is said that even divine beings desire a human body because it provides the opportunity to consciously perform this spiritual work.
The Role of Mantra in Jagrikaran
The key that opens the doorway.
The saints discovered that mantra could become the bridge between these two worlds.
Before a mantra is used for higher spiritual work, it is first activated.
As the mantra becomes awakened, it develops the ability to carry spiritual energy into the Astral World.
And once the connection is established, energy can also return from the Astral World to the physical world.
This continuous exchange is the foundation of Jagrikaran .
The Four Stages of Pran Pratishtha
Not every divine presence appears in the same way.
Pran Pratishtha is described as having four stages , but the first two are the most important for understanding how divine energy functions:
Ardh Pratyakshikaran (Partial Manifestation)
Purn Pratyakshikaran (Complete Manifestation)
Although both involve the movement of energy between the physical and Astral Worlds, they are very different.
Ardh Pratyakshikaran
Present, active… but invisible.
In Ardh Pratyakshikaran , spiritual energy is sent from the physical world into the Astral World and then returns.
However, it does not take a visible physical form.
The energy is present.
It is active.
It performs its work.
But it cannot be seen with ordinary eyes.
Think of Wi-Fi .
You cannot see the signal around you, yet your phone connects to it, downloads information, and performs countless tasks.
The signal is invisible, but its effects are real.
In the same way, divine energies in Ardh Pratyakshikaran remain active even though they are not physically visible.
This is why Pran Pratishthit temples are considered spiritually alive.
The deity is active…
The energy is present…
Yet it remains beyond ordinary vision.
Purn Pratyakshikaran
When the invisible takes a visible form.
The next stage is far rarer.
In Purn Pratyakshikaran , energy again travels through the Astral World.
But this time, when it returns, it takes a physical form that can be seen with ordinary eyes.
This is considered one of the highest spiritual accomplishments and is said to have been attained by only a handful of great saints.
The Story of Maharaj Tulsidas Ji
A glimpse of Complete Manifestation.
One of the most well-known examples is associated with Maharaj Shri Tulsidas Ji .
It is said that he once visited a temple where the installed deity was Lord Krishna .
However, Tulsidas Ji wished to have the darshan of Lord Sita Ram .
The people present tried to stop him, explaining that this temple was dedicated to Lord Krishna.
Tulsidas Ji simply replied that there was no difference.
When they asked him to prove it, he invoked his spiritual power.
According to this account, the form of Lord Krishna transformed into the form of Lord Sita Ram , allowing everyone present to witness it.
This event is described as an example of Purn Pratyakshikaran —where a subtle reality becomes physically visible.
The Science Behind Complete Manifestation
How did Maharaj Tulsidas Ji make the invisible visible?
This naturally raises a fascinating question.
How was Maharaj Tulsidas Ji able to perform such an extraordinary spiritual act?
According to this understanding, it became possible because he had developed an exceptionally powerful Space Element (Akash Tattva).
Once his Space Element was fully awakened, he first directed physical energy into the Astral World .
Then, through that same Space Element, he invoked energy back from the Astral World.
But the returning energy was no longer ordinary.
With the assistance of Siddhis and divine astral energies , that subtle astral energy was transformed into physical form. As a result, what was invisible became visible before everyone present.
This rare process is known as Purn Pratyakshikaran (Complete Manifestation).
Only a very small number of highly advanced saints are believed to attain this ability.
Why Are Divine Beings Invisible?
Present in this world… but beyond ordinary sight.
If Complete Manifestation is so rare, then another question arises.
How do deities normally work?
According to this understanding, divine beings generally function through Ardh Pratyakshikaran (Partial Manifestation).
They remain present in the physical world, but they do not take a permanent physical form.
They guide.
They bless.
They respond to prayers.
Yet they remain invisible to ordinary eyes.
What Does 'Jagrit' Really Mean?
An awakened presence that continues to work.
People often say,
“This deity is Jagrit.”
But what does that actually mean?
It means the divine presence is spiritually active.
The deity keeps its Space Element open, allowing it to remain connected with the physical world while existing in the Astral World.
Because divine beings function through the Space Element, they do not require a physical body to carry out their work.
This is why people experience their blessings even though they cannot physically see them.
Their presence is active…
Their influence is real…
But they continue to work through Ardh Pratyakshikaran.
When Does Complete Manifestation Become Possible?
Only when the Space Element reaches its highest potential.
Complete Manifestation becomes possible only when a practitioner’s Space Element has been developed to an extraordinary level.
At that stage, subtle astral energy can be transformed into visible physical energy.
This is why Purn Pratyakshikaran is regarded as one of the rarest spiritual accomplishments.
The Two Hidden Powers Behind the Space Element
Every spiritual transformation depends on two invisible abilities.
This leads to another mystery.
How does energy actually travel between the physical world and the Astral World?
The answer lies in two important spiritual powers:
Grahan Shakti (Receiving Power)
Prayog Shakti (Application Power)
Together, these make the entire process possible.
Grahan Shakti
The ability to receive and send energy.
In Ashaeiynn, Grahan Shakti is associated with Shiv Tattva .
It is the ability to absorb energy from the physical world and send it into the Astral World.
Imagine using an elevator.
The elevator’s job is to carry people from one floor to another.
In the same way, Grahan Shakti carries physical energy from the material world into the Astral World.
The stronger a person’s Grahan Shakti, the greater the amount of energy they can transfer.
Prayog Shakti
The power that brings transformed energy back.
Once energy reaches the Astral World, another process begins.
The transformed energy must return.
The ability that brings this energy back into the physical world is called Prayog Shakti .
If Grahan Shakti is the journey upward,
Prayog Shakti is the journey back.
One sends.
The other returns.
Together, they complete the spiritual cycle.
Why Is Everyone's Spiritual Capacity Different?
Every person receives and applies energy differently.
No two people have exactly the same body or the same planetary influences.
For this reason, every person naturally has a different level of Grahan Shakti and Prayog Shakti .
This means that two people performing the same spiritual practice may still experience different results.
The saints understood this limitation.
Instead of creating separate methods for every individual, they searched for something universal.
That search eventually led them to mantras .
A Hidden Mathematical Pattern
What do mantras and mathematics have in common?
At first glance, spirituality and mathematics seem completely unrelated.
But the saints noticed something remarkable.
Think about the number π (Pi).
No matter how large or small a circle is, one relationship always remains the same.
The ratio between its circumference and diameter is always π (3.14159…) .
Every circle is different.
Yet the ratio never changes.
Why Is This Similar to Mantras?
Different mantras… one universal principle.
The saints discovered something similar in mantras.
There are countless mantras.
Each has a different purpose.
Each carries a different vibration.
Yet they observed that all of them follow a common spiritual principle.
Just as every circle follows the same value of π , every mantra is believed to work through the same underlying spiritual mechanism.
Understanding that hidden principle is the key to understanding how a mantra is awakened , how it becomes energized , and how it begins working through the Astral World .
That is the mystery we will explore next.
The Mystery Behind the Number Nine
Why did saints discover the same hidden pattern in different mantras?
Now let’s return to the concepts of Grahan Shakti and Prayog Shakti .
While working with different mantras, saints discovered something remarkable.
Although every mantra has a different purpose, vibration, and method of practice, they all follow one common spiritual principle—a 1:9 ratio .
This is one of the reasons why the number 9 is considered sacred in spirituality.
But what does this ratio actually mean?
Once a mantra has been fully energized (Jagrit) , every nine chants of that mantra are sent from the physical world to the Astral World through the Space Element .
After completing its subtle journey there, only one empowered mantra returns to the physical world.
This returning mantra is known as the Prayog Shakti of that mantra.
In simple words:
Grahan Shakti sends the mantra from the physical world to the Astral World.
Nine chants are required for this subtle journey.
One empowered mantra returns.
That returned mantra itself becomes the Prayog Shakti , which can later be invoked whenever spiritual work needs to be performed.

You can think of it like sending raw material into a factory. Many pieces go inside, but what comes back is a finished product, ready to be used. Similarly, the mantra that returns from the Astral World is no longer an ordinary chant—it has become Prayog Shakti .
Before a Mantra Can Travel
Every mantra must first awaken before it can enter the Astral World.
A mantra cannot be sent to the Astral World from the very beginning.
First, it must reach a specific level of spiritual awakening known as Jagriti .
Every mantra has its own Jagriti count, and until that number is completed, the mantra continues gathering strength in the physical world.
For example, the Panchakshar Mantra is traditionally believed to become awakened only after approximately 21 lakh chants .
Only after reaching this stage does the mantra become capable of entering the Astral World.
This is why every mantra has a different Jagriti requirement before it becomes spiritually active.
One Rule Shared by Every Awakened Mantra
Different mantras, but the same spiritual formula.
Although the Jagriti count differs from one mantra to another, the working principle after awakening remains the same.
Once a mantra becomes Jagrit:
Every nine chants are sent to the Astral World through Grahan Shakti .
From those nine chants, one empowered mantra returns to the physical world.
That returning mantra becomes the Prayog Shakti of the practitioner.
This is why the 1:9 ratio is regarded as a universal spiritual principle in mantra practice.
Why Some Saints Preferred 1:11
Adding a margin for greater certainty.
Although the fundamental ratio is understood as 1:9 , many saints later practiced using 1:11 .
One explanation is that the additional two chants acted as a margin of safety.

Just as people often keep a small reserve while planning an important task, the extra chants ensured that even if there was a slight distraction or imperfection during chanting, the required nine chants would still be completed successfully.
There may be deeper spiritual reasons behind using 1:11 , but this is one practical understanding of why many saints adopted this ratio.
The Biggest Mistake People Make During Mantra Practice
Many seekers stop just when the real journey is about to begin.
One of the biggest misunderstandings in mantra practice is believing that the prescribed number of chants is the final goal.
For example, if a mantra is said to become Jagrit after 3 lakh chants , many practitioners complete those 3 lakh chants and stop there, believing that the mantra has achieved its full power.
In reality, those chants only awaken the mantra.
Its actual spiritual journey begins after it becomes Jagrit.
The Journey After Jagriti
Awakening the mantra is only the beginning.
As discussed earlier, once a mantra becomes Jagrit, it starts following the 1:9 spiritual ratio .
This process continues until sufficient spiritual power is accumulated.

For example, if a mantra becomes Jagrit after 3 lakh chants , then approximately 30 lakh chants are required for it to accumulate enough returned mantra power to reach the stage of Ardh Pratakshikaran .
This is why saints never considered Jagriti to be the destination.
It was only the starting point.
Measuring the Strength of a Mantra
The Jagriti count reveals the mantra’s true potential.
If you want to understand how powerful a mantra can become, first find out its Jagriti count .
Every mantra has its own awakening point.
Some may require 3 lakh chants , while others may require 21 lakh or even more.
Once that number is reached, the 1:9 principle comes into effect. From there, the practitioner continues chanting until the mantra gathers sufficient spiritual strength.
The higher the Jagriti count, the greater the effort needed to awaken it. But the farther it journeys through the dimensions of the universe, the more powerful it becomes.
Why These Mantras Are Beyond Planetary Influence
Their source is no longer limited to the physical world.
An ordinary mantra chanted by a human being is still connected to the physical body and therefore remains under planetary influence.
However, after completing its spiritual process, the mantra no longer carries the limitations of its physical origin.
Because its source is now the Astral World rather than the human body, planetary influences no longer govern its working.
This is why such mantras are believed to function independently of planetary limitations and can accomplish spiritual work that ordinary human effort alone cannot.
The Mystery Behind the Ashaeiynn Mantra
Why does this mantra require such a large number of chants?
Now comes a very important question.
If many mantras become energized after a few lakh chants, why does the initiated mantra in Ashaeiynn require 2 crore chants before it becomes Jagrit?
The answer lies in how far the mantra has to travel.
A mantra that works only within the lower dimensions requires less spiritual energy to become awakened.
The initiated mantra in Ashaeiynn, however, is believed to travel all the way to the 14th Dimension , known as Vaikunth Lok
Since the 14th Dimension is considered the highest dimension in this framework, the mantra must gather enough spiritual strength to complete that entire journey.
For this reason, its Jagriti count is 2 crore chants .
Only after completing these 2 crore chants does the mantra become capable of beginning its journey through the Astral World.
The Next Stage Begins After Jagriti
Awakening the mantra is only the first milestone.
Once the mantra becomes Jagrit, the 1:9 spiritual ratio begins to operate, just as explained earlier.
To accumulate approximately 2 crore Prayog Shakti , nearly 20 crore chants are required.
In other words, the number of Prayog Shakti needed for Ardh Pratakshikaran is equal to the mantra’s Jagriti count.
This is why the complete practice extends far beyond the initial 2 crore chants.
Why This Prayog Shakti Is Considered Unique
It has already completed the highest journey.
The Prayog Shakti created from this mantra is believed to have completed its journey through the 14th Dimension .
Since the 14th Dimension represents the highest level of existence in this understanding, the mantra is said to have passed through every dimension of the universe before returning.
Because nothing within creation exists beyond these fourteen dimensions, no ordinary spiritual or planetary force is considered higher than the vibration carried by this Prayog Shakti.

This is why the saying “Ram Naam Satya Hai” holds such significance. According to this understanding, it has journeyed through all fourteen dimensions, leaving nothing within the universe beyond its reach.
Why the Practice Takes So Long
The greater the destination, the greater the preparation.
Reaching the highest dimension naturally requires greater spiritual preparation.
This is why the Ashaeiynn mantra takes much longer to awaken than many other mantras.
Its destination is not a lower realm but the highest dimension described by Guru Tattva.
The greater the destination, the greater the number of chants required to prepare the mantra for that journey.
How Prayog Shakti Reduces Planetary Influence
A stronger vibration naturally overcomes a weaker one.
Suppose a practitioner continues chanting until approximately 22 crore chants are completed.
According to this understanding, this would generate around 2.5 crore Prayog Shakti .
At this stage, the vibration of the practitioner’s Prayog Shakti becomes stronger than the vibration created by the planetary influences affecting that person.
As a result, planetary effects gradually lose their ability to dominate the practitioner’s spiritual journey.
This is why anyone wishing to reduce the suffering caused by planetary conditions is encouraged to develop Prayog Shakti , rather than focusing only on the physical act of chanting.
Why the Space Element Is Called Miraculous
The real transformation happens beyond the physical world.
The mantras chanted in the physical world are still connected to the human body and therefore remain under planetary influence.
However, the Prayog Shakti that returns from the Astral World is no longer governed by those planetary forces.
This is why the Space Element (Akash Tattva) is regarded as one of the most powerful elements of the human body.

For people believed to be affected by strong planetary conditions—such as Kaal Sarp Dosh , Guru Chandal Dosh , or similar astrological combinations—the real solution, according to this understanding, is to gradually strengthen their Prayog Shakti by following the spiritual system established by the saints.
Step by step, the practitioner accumulates Prayog Shakti, and every awakened mantra that returns from the Astral World becomes a permanent spiritual asset.
It is never considered wasted.
While ordinary chanting performed in the physical world remains influenced by planetary movements, the Prayog Shakti that has returned from the Astral World is believed to work independently of them.
This is why such mantras are regarded as capable of producing extraordinary spiritual results.
